name: job-application-pipeline-marketplace
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the job-application-pipeline plugin.

plugins.name: job-application-pipeline
plugins.description: Automates job-application prep: a one-time interview to capture quantified experience, CV/cover-letter template design, and a schedulable job search that ranks postings against your priorities and drafts tailored applications for the ones worth pursuing. Never submits an application on its own.
